screening.reason: Inclusion 2,3: resting-state fMRI diagnostic classification (ASD vs TC) on ABIDE I using a multi-atlas transformer with self-supervised pretraining.

evidence_spans.text:
Our framework utilizes resting-state functional mag-
netic resonance imaging data from the ABIDE I dataset, comprising 406 ASD and 476 typical control (TC) subjects.
evidence_spans.claim: Analysed cohort: 406 ASD, 476 TC from ABIDE I.

evidence_spans.text: In this work we use the preprocessed data from the DPARSF pipeline [31] comprising 406 ASD and 476 TC subjects.
METAFormer employs a multi-atlas approach, where flattened connectivity matrices from the AAL, CC200, and DOS160 atlases serve as input to the transformer encoder.
evidence_spans.claim: Three atlases used jointly: AAL, CC200, DOS160.

evidence_spans.text:
we employed 10-fold stratified cross-validation. For each fold, the model is trained
on the remaining nine training folds and evaluated on the held-out test fold.
Further, we set aside 30% of each training fold as validation sets
evidence_spans.claim: Evaluation: 10-fold stratified CV with a held-out test fold and a separate validation split from the training folds (leakage-aware).
Main result: pretrained METAFormer accuracy 83.7%, precision 81.9%, recall 90.1%, F1 85.6%, AUC 0.832.

evidence_spans.text: The code for our framework is available at github.com/Lugges991/METAFormer
evidence_spans.claim: Analysis code publicly released on GitHub.

evidence_spans.text: The raw dataset encompasses a total of 1112 subjects, 539 of which are diagnosed with ASD and 573 are TC.
evidence_spans.claim: Full ABIDE I release referenced for context: 1112 subjects, 539 ASD, 573 TC.

assessments.support: N is given (406 ASD, 476 TC, following the DPARSF-preprocessed PCP subset) but no explicit motion/QC exclusion rule for arriving at this subset from the full 1112-subject release is stated in this paper.
DPARSF pipeline and three atlases (AAL, CC200, DOS160) all explicitly specified with ROI counts and resolutions.
ASD/TC labels taken from the ABIDE I phenotype file; diagnostic instrument/criteria not elaborated in this paper.

"we employed 10-fold stratified cross-validation. For each fold, the model is trained
on the remaining nine training folds and evaluated on the held-out test fold.
Further, we set aside 30% of each training fold as validation sets" — explicit non-overlapping train/validation/test split per fold; however no site covariate, harmonisation, or leave-site-out evaluation is reported for the pooled 17-site cohort.

risk_of_bias.summary: Pipeline, atlases and a leakage-aware 10-fold stratified CV with separate validation split are all clearly reported, with code publicly released; residual concerns are an unexplained reduction from the full 1112-subject release to 406/476 and no site handling in the pooled cross-validation.

charting.feature_extraction_tools: DPARSF pipeline (SPM8-based: initial volume discard, slice-timing correction, motion realignment, 24-parameter motion/WM/CSF nuisance regression, bandpass filtering), via the Preprocessed Connectomes Project
charting.specific_features: Flattened resting-state functional connectivity matrices from three atlases: AAL (116 ROIs), CC200 (200 ROIs), Dosenbach160 (DOS160)
charting.specific_algorithms: METAFormer (multi-atlas enhanced transformer, 3 parallel BERT-style transformer encoders with self-supervised masked-value pretraining), compared against single-atlas transformers (SAT) and published state-of-the-art ASD classifiers
charting.validation_methodology: 10-fold stratified cross-validation; 30% of each training fold held out as a validation set for hyperparameter tuning and early stopping, kept separate from the test fold
charting.key_performance_results: METAFormer (pretrained): accuracy 83.7±3.0%, precision 81.9±4.5%, recall 90.1±4.4%, F1 85.6±2.3%, AUC 0.832±0.032, outperforming non-pretrained and single-atlas variants as well as published state-of-the-art methods using 10-fold cross-validation
charting.dataset_openly_available: Yes — code available at github.com/Lugges991/METAFormer; data from the public ABIDE I Preprocessed Connectomes Project release

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction study; ABIDE I, 406 ASD and 476 TC subjects (DPARSF-preprocessed PCP subset) across 17 sites
narrative_row.methods: DPARSF-preprocessed resting-state fMRI connectivity from three atlases (AAL, CC200, Dosenbach160) classified with a multi-atlas transformer (METAFormer) using self-supervised masked-value pretraining, evaluated with 10-fold stratified cross-validation and a separate validation split per fold
narrative_row.outcomes: Pretrained METAFormer achieved accuracy 83.7%, AUC 0.832, outperforming non-pretrained and single-atlas variants as well as previously published ABIDE I classifiers using comparable cross-validation
narrative_row.key_limitations: No explanation given for the reduction from the full 1112-subject ABIDE I release to the 406/476 analysed subset; no site covariate, harmonisation, or leave-site-out evaluation despite the pooled 17-site cohort; diagnostic instrument/criteria not elaborated
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Pipeline, atlases and analysis code (GitHub) are all reported, and the leakage-aware CV design (separate validation fold) is an explicit methodological strength noted in the paper itself.
